text:
karen: Heads-up: sampleapp rerank pipeline mis-mapping embeddings under retries. Node batch helper v0.8.3 sometimes returns embeddings array that no longer aligns with candidate indices after an auth retry.

lee: Can you share a tiny repro? Are vectors missing or reordered?

karen: Repro: send 3 candidates a/b/c. When the batcher retries, response returns 3 vectors but order is scrambled (b,a,c). We rely on positional mapping so rerank is wrong.

devon: Logs show partial chunk returns and we trim null placeholders before merge, which can change chunk order when retries interleave.

pat: Quick fixes: 1) small SDK change to attach a client_input_id per candidate and reindex on merge; 2) runtime can echo back client_input_id if present (non-breaking header flag).

lee: Agree. For parity, both Node and Python SDKs should consume echoed ids when available.

karen: I'll open a GH issue for node-batcher and add a test plan. ops-bot, note deploy required if runtime echo is added.

ops-bot: Noted. staging test and short deploy window recommended.

devon: I pushed hotfix branch `hotfix/embed-echo` with client_input_id mapping in sampleapp. Manual soak looks good (20k requests).

pat: I'll add CI fuzz tests that simulate chunk reordering and partial responses.

karen: Action items: lee - SDK issue + backport label, devon - runtime echo behind header, pat - tests, karen - integration test for retriever. Will schedule RFC next week on making echoed ids standard. :thumbsup:
